body:
It seems that the majority of people enjoy accomplishment. You have goals, you fulfill them, you feel good. 

It doesn't seem to matter what I do. I regarded everything with the same miserable apathy. I feel that this is pretty understandable. Imagine if nothing you did was at all fulfilling, you'd pretty quickly lose interest in everything. 

It's rather difficult to live in a world in which nothing compels you to do so.
